solutions.title: Search each word
solutions.strategy: Run a board DFS independently for each candidate word.

timeComplexity.explanation: For w words, DFS can branch through up to four neighbors across word length l from each board cell.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The visited matrix tracks board cells and the recursion stack is bounded by the searched word length.

solutions.title: Trie board DFS
solutions.strategy: Build a trie of words and traverse the board once per trie prefix path.

timeComplexity.explanation: Trie construction uses total word characters, and board DFS explores valid prefix paths instead of every word separately.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The trie stores the dictionary plus recursion state for board DFS.
